historical_registry.evidence: Existing scheduled-job failure markers retained; payment, refund, booking, form, trial and admin intent now persists in deliveries.
Existing per-item commits and 900-second worker timeout retained; fenced delivery claims cover interrupted sends.
Dedicated business SMS number; destination-based inbound routing and retired-number ownership protection.
Credit-note suffix uses maximum plus one under a document lock; failed reversals retain issued numbers.
Order reaper cancels failed and pending intents; late successful payment is recorded and refunded.
Web/mobile discount ceiling and PIN setup share a hook; PIN changes audited, hashing offloaded and guesses limited.
Stripe requests use a bounded 10-second transport with no hidden network retries. Required money locks remain transactional.
Plan/staff/setup business locks use FOR NO KEY UPDATE and refresh current values.
Replacement cancels the previous subscription; an older subscription event cannot refund its payment history.
Message and broadcast action keys survive lost responses and reset for a changed request.
Inbox compares timestamps using the replica SQL representation.
Public booking, reschedule, cancel and shop use audited run_command; matching requests serialize before side effects.
Client create/update replay; normalized contact locks and explicit ambiguity rejection; merge locks and pending-money guard.
Redis-backed limits outside development and trusted-hop request IP parsing; shared PIN/admin limits.
Gift-card split tender is a separate product capability, explicitly excluded by the approved hardening plan. Standalone manager redemption remains supported.
Gift-card bearer codes are restricted to manager sync streams, matching redeem authorization.
Held-order ledger filtering aggregates cash/refund/deposit entries once per business; parity test retains ledger semantics.
Pickup schedule/count reads are batched: seeded regression measured 104 queries before, at most six after.
Storage adapter cached; blocking S3 head/delete calls run off the event loop.
Full money sync is deliberate. No unapproved history window or ledger truncation was introduced.
Offline QA now tests hours; booking and notes are explicitly online-only.
Auth-error and missing-bank-link browser regressions added and passed. Real bank/terminal flows and native security/onboarding are explicit manual QA; native automation expansion remains a follow-up.
Verified cookie/Kratos documentation; no duplicate auth rewrite.
Updated schema, delivery/jobs/SMS documentation; prior documentation corrections retained.
Refund HTTP commands require a retry key; provider-reference reconciliation prevents duplicate refund rows.
Deposit/order/manual refunds share credit-note creation, ledger application and durable receipt intent.
Deposit lookup now uses scoped(). A booking_id index requires a concrete measured schema proposal, not an automatic model change.
Inbound candidates are scoped by assigned destination business before matching phone numbers.
Reconcile commits and isolates each business; one provider failure does not abort remaining businesses.
Email/SMS/push share a lifecycle-managed HTTP pool in API and worker; isolated calls close their temporary client.
PIN hashing and verification run in a worker thread.
Intake tenant queries now use scoped(). Cross-tenant job indexes require production-shaped EXPLAIN evidence and separate schema approval.
POS cash/terminal/refund keys survive retries; unchanged saved sales are reused after ambiguous payment responses.
Remote hook generations discard stale completions.
Async actions have a synchronous in-flight guard.
Calendar/agenda queries retain arbitrary-duration overlapping visits.
Mobile inbox uses FlatList. SQL pagination/search redesign remains a measured-growth follow-up; no silent row cap hides old conversations.
Pending moves clear when outside the displayed window; undo becomes available only after a successful move.
Public day-load failure and retry are distinct from slot-load errors.
Shared manager predicate; invoice numbering serialized; existing frontend/backend ledger-state tests retained and held-order parity added.

Missing Canadian zones added; admin has bounded audit/client-related activity reads. Resource management is separate product scope; append-only audit triggers need concrete approval as required by the plan.
Admin person detail now reads Client.user_id. Public API routes remain supported even where the app chooses a hosted setup flow; absence of one frontend caller is not proof of dead API.
Added hook races, public contract/form/day failures, file storage checks and anonymous tax-rate regression; existing integration coverage retained.
Seat release and daily synchronization lock/refetch the business before calculating seats.
Locked plan reads refresh already-loaded rows.
Checkout provider keys include effective parameters so a changed plan/seat/trial request gets a distinct attempt.
Trial reminders persist a stable scope and per-channel delivery intent.
Removed unused retry-label/image-picker alternate actions and the unused statement print template from both UI contracts/renderers.
Prior documentation corrections retained; current changed surfaces documented.
Mobile bank setup is documented as a Connect link, not a web-only feature.
One refund builder applies provider results, credit notes, ledger transitions and delivery intent.
